name: Andrews
headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
intro: A versioned record of the systems, products, investigations, and engineering outcomes I have worked on.
bio: I am a senior full-stack software engineer focused on frontend architecture, product engineering, and scalable web systems.
This ledger captures meaningful work over time without exposing confidential project data. Entries are selected, sanitized, and reviewed before publication.

principles.title: Outcomes over activity
principles.description: Commits are supporting evidence. Public records focus on the initiative, contribution, and result.

principles.title: Evidence before claims
principles.description: Implementation, ownership, and impact are described only as strongly as the available evidence supports.

principles.title: Privacy by construction
principles.description: Private project analysis and public publishing are separated by an explicit review and approval boundary.
